question_english: What distinguishes an Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) from an Intrusion Detection System (IDS)?
options_english: IDS actively blocks network traffic while IPS exclusively records and logs operational events
IDS functions exclusively on physical hardware while IPS operates manually on paper forms
There is no technical or functional operational difference between IDS and IPS systems

explanation_english: IPS actively blocks detected threat traffic, while IDS primarily detects and alerts. In contrast, an Intrusion Prevention System operates inline, actively blocking, dropping, or terminating malicious network traffic packets automatically in real-time.
